name: lydite-api-extractor-pin
description: Version pin for @microsoft/api-extractor, the comparison behind a TypeScript component's api_surface opt-in. Not a package lydite builds or publishes: it exists so Dependabot can see this version and open bump PRs, and so `npm ci` installs it deterministically. api-extractor carries its own TypeScript as a locked dependency, so the compiler that reads a declaration is pinned here too. See internal/tsapisurface.
